title: Benchmark more open decision models on any hardware
description: Survey (docs/decision-models-survey.md, 2026-09-23) found a dozen open Laya-like System 1 decision models. Goal: measure each one's bias on the same tasks, cues and floors as Jev and Laya, with one engine-adapter pattern (optional pip extras per engine, device auto-detect for MPS, CPU and CUDA, ONNX or GGUF fallback where the model ships one) so the harness runs on any machine with one command. Each child story: adapter in the record's shape, timing on our Mac, predictions written before the first run, every existing cell answered, RESULTS.md column.
right_now_summary: Adapters and the cross-hardware runner are being built to benchmark open decision models on shared tasks.
